what_it_is.prose: HEX20 is a small-satellite company dual-headquartered in Thiruvananthapuram (Technopark), Kerala, India and Adelaide, South Australia. Provides cost-effective satellite platforms, customized hardware, and advanced sensor technologies for CubeSat and SmallSat form factors, with mission-as-a-service offering (design, build, integrate, test, launch, operate). India operations launched 'Nila' satellite — Kerala's first privately developed satellite — aboard SpaceX Transporter-13 on 15 March 2025 (developed in just 4 months; 3U tech demonstrator & payload host for DCube actuators). Second satellite KOYO launched July 2026 for Taiwan's National Central University. Multi-launch agreement signed with Skyroot Aerospace (Aug 2026) for 3 dedicated Vikram missions from Q4 2027 to deploy EO and demo satellites. Lunar mission partnership with ispace (Japan) and COSPAR — plans to fly a satellite in lunar orbit in 2028-2029 focused on PNT (Positioning, Navigation and Timing) and COSPAR. Ground Station functions as Mission Control Centre (MCC) for satellite missions.
